name: Santa Clara County Crisis Line
description: Santa Clara County's 24/7 Crisis and Suicide Prevention Lifeline (988) provides immediate support for mental health and substance use crises and connects callers to county behavioral health services and mobile response teams.
fullDescription: Santa Clara County's 24/7 Crisis and Suicide Prevention Lifeline (988) provides immediate support for mental health and substance use crises and connects callers to county behavioral health services and mobile response teams.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 suicide and crisis support
- Mental health and substance use crisis intervention
- Referrals to county behavioral health services
- Interpretation in more than 200 languages
- Connection to mobile crisis response teams when needed
howToGetIt: Call or text 988 anytime. If your phone doesn't have a 408, 650, or 669 area code, call 1-800-704-0900 and press 1 to reach Santa Clara County's local counselors. The same 800 number is for non-emergency behavioral health questions. Free, anonymous, and confidential.
keywords: Santa Clara County, crisis line, suicide hotline, behavioral health, mobile crisis, multilingual, mental health emergency
